# GEOX — Earth Intelligence Sovereign Kernel (15 Public Tools)
> Doctrine: Physics before narrative. Governed evidence only.
> Surface: generated from src/geox_mcp/tools_manifest.yaml

## 1. Canonical Tool Surface

1. **geox_well_ingest**: Load well log data from LAS, SEG-Y, DST, deviation, or tops files. Auto-detects format.
2. **geox_petrophysics**: Unified petrophysics: Vsh, porosity, Sw, permeability, net pay, LEM inference, QC. Modes: generate, verify, lem_inference, stoip_feed, qc.
3. **geox_seismic_ingest**: SEG-Y I/O, header inspection, export.
4. **geox_seismic_compute**: Seismic computation: forward model, well tie, attributes, wavelet extraction, inversion.
5. **geox_seismic_interpret**: Unified seismic interpretation: horizon/fault picking, RSI pipeline, vision, contrast detection. Modes: horizon_contrast, fault_sticks, volume_frame, blend, rsi_pipeline, contrast, vision.
6. **geox_subsurface_model**: Subsurface model building: joint inversion, gravity/magnetic forward, MT forward.
7. **geox_basin**: Unified basin intelligence: profile, resolve, macrostrat, backstrip, mass balance, thermal maturity, map context, deep time, tectonic reconstruction.
8. **geox_sequence**: Unified stratigraphy: sequence analysis, biostratigraphic parsing and falsification. Modes: correlation, biostrat_parse, biostrat_falsify.
9. **geox_geomechanics**: Geomechanical analysis: bulk/shear/young modulus, poisson ratio, acoustic impedance, stress polygon.
10. **geox_deep_time_state**: Earth State Vector through deep time: GPTS, CO2, sea level, temperature, paleogeography.
11. **geox_claim**: Unified claim lifecycle: create, validate, challenge, seal, evidence, consequence, optionality, cascade, feedback integrity, truth challenge.
12. **geox_prospect**: Prospect evaluation: volumetrics, POS, EVOI, risk assessment. Modes: screen, evaluate.
13. **geox_gravmag_studio**: Gravity/magnetic studio: forward modeling and screening. Modes: open, screen.
14. **geox_well_desk**: Well desk: interactive view, publish rendered panel, render well panel. Modes: open, publish, render.
15. **geox_surface_status**: Federation-standard registry probe: tool discovery and health status.

## 2. Agent Reasoning Logic
- Evidence before interpretation.
- Governance stays server-side.
- App-enabled workspace URI: `ui://geox/workspace-v1.html` (text/html;profile=mcp-app).
